retail_ecommerce.label: Retail & E-Commerce
retail_ecommerce.security_posture: Cardholder data isolation, bot/fraud mitigation, edge rate limiting
retail_ecommerce.change_management: Freeze windows around peak retail events, canary rollouts, instant feature flags

financial_services.label: Financial Services & Fintech
financial_services.security_posture: Strict RBAC, encryption in transit/at rest, immutable audit logs, segregation of duties
financial_services.change_management: Controlled CAB approvals, dual review, verifiable rollback plans, reconciliation checks

healthcare.label: Healthcare & Life Sciences
healthcare.security_posture: Minimum necessary access, PHI tokenization/de-identification, BAA-compliant tooling
healthcare.change_management: Validated deployments, strict regression verification, downtime impact notices

cloud_infrastructure.label: Cloud & Distributed Infrastructure
cloud_infrastructure.security_posture: Tenant boundary enforcement, workload identity, mutual TLS, kernel/container hardening
cloud_infrastructure.change_management: Zonal/regional progressive rollouts, automated rollback on SLO burn rate

ai_ml_platform.label: AI & Machine Learning Platforms
ai_ml_platform.security_posture: Prompt/data isolation, PII redaction, model artifact provenance, tenant quota enforcement
ai_ml_platform.change_management: Shadow traffic evaluation, offline/online eval gates, canary model routing

semiconductor.label: Semiconductor & Hardware Engineering
semiconductor.security_posture: IP protection, cleanroom access control, signed firmware/secure boot
semiconductor.change_management: Strict sign-off gates, golden reference comparison, hardware-in-the-loop verification

mobile_applications.label: Mobile Application Engineering
mobile_applications.security_posture: Certificate pinning, secure keychain/keystore storage, minimal permissions
mobile_applications.change_management: Phased store rollouts, remote config kill switches, crashlytics monitoring

cybersecurity.label: Cybersecurity
cybersecurity.change_management: Out-of-band break-glass paths, policy-as-code dry runs before enforcement

networking_telecom.label: Networking & Telecommunications
networking_telecom.security_posture: RPKI/BGP route filtering, DDoS scrubbing, management-plane isolation
networking_telecom.change_management: Maintenance windows, out-of-band console access, automated pre/post route diff checks

enterprise_saas_customer.label: Enterprise SaaS, Solutions Architecture & Customer Engineering
enterprise_saas_customer.security_posture: SSO/SAML/OIDC integration, tenant isolation, customer data residency
enterprise_saas_customer.change_management: Customer communication plans, staged onboarding, success criteria sign-off
